reason: 该插件面向终端用户提供界面化账户监控功能，在 DSH 会话界面显示可停靠/可拖拽的小部件并展示 DeepSeek API 余额与服务状态，属导航面板类工具；其后端路由与客户端挂载方式来自仓库说明，且通过 DSH 凭据读取 API key，因此存在网络访问与凭据读取相关的低到中等风险。

summaries.zh: 这是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在界面中提供可停靠/可拖拽的账户 HUD，展示 API 余额与服务状态，并在支持时提供账户侧边栏入口。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows a dockable or draggable account HUD in the UI for API balance and service status, with an optional account tab in the sidebar when available.

reasons.code: The plugin registers backend routes for balance and status queries, implying periodic remote data retrieval.
Functionality depends on DeepSeek API key configuration from DSH credentials/settings.
It adds a dockable/floatable widget to DSH UI and optionally registers a sidebar account tab.
Runtime metadata and peer dependencies target DSH web platform client/runtime/react integration.
